local root = workspace:FindFirstChild('Phase1Map')
if not root then return 'no Phase1Map' end
local rp = RaycastParams.new(); rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include; rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Terrain}; rp.IgnoreWater = false
local out, bad = {}, {}
local n = 0
for _, area in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
  local models, parts, unanch, plastic, floating, buried, lights = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
  for _, m in ipairs(area:GetDescendants()) do
    if m:IsA('Model') and m:GetAttribute('PlanKey') then
      models += 1
      local cf, sz = m:GetBoundingBox()
      local bottom = cf.Y - sz.Y / 2
      local r = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(cf.X, bottom + 200, cf.Z), Vector3.new(0, -500, 0), rp)
      local g = r and r.Position.Y
      if g and (m:GetAttribute('YOffset') or 0) == 0 then
        local gap = bottom - g
        if gap > 3 and sz.Y < 60 then floating += 1; if #bad < 25 then table.insert(bad, string.format('FLOAT %s %s gap=%.1f at (%.0f,%.0f)', m:GetAttribute('PlanKey'), m.Name, gap, cf.X, cf.Z)) end end
        if gap < -(sz.Y * 0.5) then buried += 1; if #bad < 25 then table.insert(bad, string.format('BURIED %s %s gap=%.1f h=%.1f', m:GetAttribute('PlanKey'), m.Name, gap, sz.Y)) end end
      end
      n += 1; if n % 200 == 0 then task.wait() end
    elseif m:IsA('BasePart') then
      parts += 1
      if not m.Anchored then unanch += 1 end
      if m.Material == Enum.Material.Plastic then plastic += 1 end
    elseif m:IsA('PointLight') then lights += 1 end
  end
  table.insert(out, string.format('%s: models=%d parts=%d unanchored=%d plastic=%d floating=%d buried=%d lights=%d', area.Name, models, parts, unanch, plastic, floating, buried, lights))
end
return table.concat(out, '\n') .. '\n' .. table.concat(bad, '\n')
